documents.name: Emerald Park
documents.summary: Emerald Park is a theme park destination in Ashbourne, retained for distinctive visitor-experience quality.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Ireland’s strongest ride-led destination, combining major coasters with broad family attractions in a full-day park.
